name: Sunken Ford Crossing
enter_line: Cold river water swirls around sunken wagon axles where the border watch fell.
weather_lines: Fine drizzle dimples the rust-brown current.
Low river mist hides the opposite gravel bank.
Gusts whip cold spray off the willow weir.
ambient_sounds_text: Water gurgles through broken wheel spokes.
Wet leather creaks under heavy footsteps.
Crows croak from half-submerged alder posts.

name: Thornwick Timber Palisade
enter_line: Sharpened stakes and damp wool smoke guard the last market town before the fens.
weather_lines: Grey sleet hisses against charcoal braziers.
Thick morning fog clings to shingled eaves.
Chill wind rattles shuttered merchant stalls.
ambient_sounds_text: Whetstones scrape along notched levy spears.
Muffled voices bargain behind barred doors.
Watch-boots thump across wet plank walkways.

name: Fenwick Peat Flats
enter_line: Black water and swaying reeds swallow every path save the rotting corduroy planks.
weather_lines: Clammy fog hangs three paces above the peat.
Spitting rain turns moss beds into black mire.
Stagnant air smells sharply of sulfur and rot.
ambient_sounds_text: Marsh gas bubbles up through thick black mud.
Reeds rustle where no breeze stirs the mist.
Sunken timbers groan beneath careful weight.

name: Ravenwatch Signal Ridge
enter_line: Exposed granite heights where wind howls through the split shutters of an undermanned tower.
weather_lines: Driving sleet lashes the charred timber parapet.
Racing clouds tear across a pale winter moon.
Biting ridge-gales carry smoke from the valley.
ambient_sounds_text: Loose shutter slats clatter against stone.
Ravens shift uneasily along wet roof beams.
Unlit pitch barrels creak in the cold draft.

name: The Flooded Cloisters
enter_line: Knee-deep black brine laps against defaced saints inside the sinking abbey nave.
weather_lines: Cold dampness sweats down every vaulted rib.
Pale mist drifts over stagnant choir water.
Chill drafts whistle through broken lancet glass.
ambient_sounds_text: Water drips steadily from cracked stone arches.
Sodden parchment slaps softly against pillars.
Distant chains clink inside the flooded crypt.

name: Lantern Passage Defile
enter_line: Sheer slate cliffs funnel footsteps beneath iron-caged lamps that sway in dead calm.
weather_lines: Canyon fog turns lamp-light into blurry halos.
Fine slate grit sifts down in dry gusts.
Damp chill pools at the bottom of the gorge.
ambient_sounds_text: Caged oil lamps creak on rusted wall brackets.
Iron-shod boots echo twice off narrow slate.
Oil drips slowly onto worn cobblestone.

name: Greywood Haulage Yard
enter_line: Overturned timber wagons and stacked oak beams rot beneath tangled ash canopies.
weather_lines: Dappled drizzle patters on damp sawdust mats.
Heavy forest mist muffles distant bird-calls.
Cool wind sighs through overgrown bramble thickets.
ambient_sounds_text: Rusted crane chains swing with a faint clink.
Wet sawdust squelches underfoot like snow.
Branches creak high in the tangled canopy.

name: Alder Stone Span
enter_line: Three-century-old granite arches carry the sole artillery road across the swollen Alder.
weather_lines: River spray mists the scorched stone parapets.
Sharp cross-winds whip banners along the arch.
Overcast skies darken the churning rapids below.
ambient_sounds_text: River rapids boil loudly against stone cutwaters.
Boot-nails scrape across worn granite paving.
Bowstrings hum tautly in the damp river air.

name: Ironhide Bramble Ravine
enter_line: Deep tusk-gouges and snapped hunting spears scar the birches lining this dense gully.
weather_lines: Low mist tangles among thorny undergrowth.
Spitting rain darkens mud-caked ravine stones.
Still, heavy air smells of wet fur and loam.
ambient_sounds_text: Heavy breathing rumbles inside thick brush.
Snapped spear-shafts clatter under wary boots.
Dry briars rasp against leather greaves.

name: Undervault Drainage Galleries
enter_line: Dwarven brick tunnels sweat cold mineral drops beneath lead-sealed border armories.
weather_lines: Stale subterranean air tastes of lime and iron.
Cold drafts seep through cracked mortar joints.
Perpetual dark swallows torchlight ten paces out.
ambient_sounds_text: Mineral drops plink into stone drainage runnels.
Tree roots creak as they wedge brick arches.
Faint metallic hums vibrate through lead doors.

name: Redmarsh Piling Stockade
enter_line: Sinking oak palisades brace above rust-red silt where clean water sells by the gill.
weather_lines: Warm drizzle hisses on smoky sentry braziers.
Ochre marsh-fog clings low over the moat.
Hot, gritty gusts blow north from the salt-pan.
ambient_sounds_text: Leeches slap against moored supply punts.
Dice clatter inside humid canvas billet tents.
Log palisades groan as they settle into mud.

name: The Ochre Boundary Ditch
enter_line: Crooked iron markers and skull-hung willow poles divide solid turf from sucking bog.
weather_lines: Thick yellow haze blurs the horizon line.
Dry alkali wind crusts salt onto wet wool.
Pale sun glares off stagnant rust-red pools.
ambient_sounds_text: Bleached skulls rattle on dry willow poles.
Mud sucks greedily at every lifted boot.
Reeds hiss like sandpaper in hot gusts.

name: Twin Canyon Ledges
enter_line: Parallel sandstone tracks skirt a sheer sinkhole chasm under sniper-lined crags.
weather_lines: Howling canyon drafts whip cloaks across stone.
Blinding grit-squalls sweep through the notch.
Harsh midday glare bakes the red sandstone.
ambient_sounds_text: Loose pebbles skitter into the unseen gulf.
Wind whistles sharply through sandstone chimneys.
Crossbow prods click from high middle crags.

name: Bracken Tussock Basin
enter_line: Wind-carved hoodoos and thorny scrub hide alkali sinkholes and buried ambushers.
weather_lines: Swirling dust-devils blot out distant cairns.
Dry heat shimmers above cracked clay beds.
Sudden haboobs turn afternoon sky to rust.
ambient_sounds_text: Signal mirrors flash with faint metallic clicks.
Sand hisses continuously across dry scrub.
Distant whistles echo from unseen hummocks.

name: Ruptured Wardstone Crest
enter_line: A split quartz monolith hums with violet static above a dead ring of flattened grass.
weather_lines: Ozone-heavy air prickles exposed skin.
Dry static crackles before hot desert gusts.
Unnatural violet glare pulses through dust.
ambient_sounds_text: The fractured crystal hums deep in the teeth.
Blue sparks snap between iron helm-rivets.
Dead grass rustles brittly around the spire.

name: Corduroy Causeway Bog
enter_line: Half-sunken log tracks carry heavy supply wagons across bottomless red clay.
weather_lines: Warm rain turns clay tracks into slick grease.
Low bog-mist swallows torchlight at dusk.
Humid air hangs thick with peat and sweat.
ambient_sounds_text: Wagon wheels groan in deep, sucking mud.
Draft oxen snort and stamp in tangled traces.
Arrows thud softly into wet canvas covers.

name: Stilt-Granary Compound
enter_line: Limestone pillars lift the province's last dry barley stores above floodwater and rats.
weather_lines: Acrid brush-smoke curls through louver vents.
Hot wind fans embers along dry shingle eaves.
Dusty sunlight slants through barred shutters.
ambient_sounds_text: Oak shutters shudder under heavy ram blows.
Loose grain patters like rain from burst sacks.
Flames crackle hungrily beneath stone stilts.

name: Megalith Willow Hollow
enter_line: Twelve black standing stones weep bitter green miasma around bubbling clay cauldrons.
weather_lines: Stagnant, fetid air chokes out every breeze.
Sickly green mist rises off warm peat pools.
Overcast gloom dims the sunken willow ring.
ambient_sounds_text: Bone fetishes clack together in dead calm.
Thick broth bubbles in blackened clay pots.
Frogs croak out of rhythm in the dark reeds.

name: Terraced Ironstone Pit
enter_line: Sheer slate ledges drop three hundred feet into a flooded black rainwater pool.
weather_lines: Cold updrafts rise from the dark pit water.
Fine black iron-dust coats damp rock faces.
Low clouds snag along the upper quarry rim.
ambient_sounds_text: Rusted crane winches creak in canyon drafts.
Every pick-clang echoes ten times off slate.
Discarded shackles rattle along timber ledges.

name: Ironheart Twin Spires
enter_line: Black-slag bastions crown volcanic needles above cannon-swept salt-bog causeways.
weather_lines: Dry mountain winds whip dust across stone.
Blistering sun bakes the empty cistern courtyards.
Ash-tinged clouds gather over the mountain pass.
ambient_sounds_text: Heavy iron gates groan on dry bronze hinges.
Wind moans through empty stone water-channels.
Boots crunch on volcanic slag and alkali grit.

name: Oakhaven Cedar Drydocks
enter_line: Walled hill-terraces and petrified oak pilings overlook a bay choked by naval blockade.
weather_lines: Salt-heavy sea fog rolls over slate roofs.
Brisk coastal gales carry pine-pitch smoke.
Pale sun glints off blue tower ward-lamps.
ambient_sounds_text: Guild curfew bells toll across the lower town.
Surf slaps against bolted harbor boom-chains.
Shipwright hammers ring inside timber drydocks.

name: Ashen Tenement Ruins
enter_line: Blackened chimneys and smoldering cellars stretch beyond Oakhaven's cleared sightlines.
weather_lines: Wind stirs grey ash across scorched cobbles.
Cold sea drizzle hisses on warm cellar beams.
Smoke-stained fog lingers in ruined alleys.
ambient_sounds_text: Charred roof timbers groan as they settle.
Loose roof slates clatter in coastal gusts.
Furtive footsteps scrape inside dark cellars.

name: Cratered Coastal Moor
enter_line: Split shields and incendiary craters scar the heather where shield-walls shattered.
weather_lines: Horizontal sea-rain sweeps the open ridge.
Low storm clouds darken trampled peat turf.
Salt wind stings exposed cheeks and eyes.
ambient_sounds_text: Wind howls through abandoned iron pike-racks.
Gulls shriek above silent piles of dented plate.
Wet heather squelches under marching columns.

name: Ruined Abbey Triage Nave
enter_line: Lantern-lit hospital tents huddle inside roofless stone walls behind a thin picket line.
weather_lines: Night drizzle drums on tight-stretched canvas.
Sea mist drifts through broken rose-windows.
Chill wind rattles loose abbey roof-tiles.
ambient_sounds_text: Canvas tent flaps snap sharply in gusts.
Surgeons' blades clink in vinegar-filled basins.
Distant horn blasts warn of probing scouts.

name: Tilted Sea-Stack Fortress
enter_line: Atlantic breakers thunder through flooded lower halls of a sinking First-Empire keep.
weather_lines: Salt spray mists through cracked arrow slits.
Gale-force gusts whip foam across tilted stone.
Grey sea-squalls obscure the mainland cliffs.
ambient_sounds_text: Surf booms loudly inside submerged lower vaults.
Corroded bronze hinges shriek in the sea wind.
Kelp-slick flagstones squelch beneath boots.

name: Hourglass Shingle Bar
enter_line: Freezing tidewater climbs steadily across the narrow gravel spit linking tower to shore.
weather_lines: Driving spray blurs the shrinking gravel path.
Low tide-fog hides the approaching surf line.
Biting sea wind drowns out shouted commands.
ambient_sounds_text: Waves hiss and rattle across loose beach shingle.
Surf slams against the watchtower's granite base.
Water sloshes inside heavy leather boots.

name: Greywash Canal Locks
enter_line: Roaring sluices and massive bronze capstans hold back tidal surges from inland fields.
weather_lines: River mist rises thick above churning lock-gates.
Brisk wind whips spray across narrow catwalks.
Overcast gloom darkens the deep canal basin.
ambient_sounds_text: Dark water roars through half-jammed sluices.
Iron counterweight chains groan under immense load.
Bronze gears grind inside wet stone housings.

name: Rust-Scree Testing Ground
enter_line: Crushed boulders and gouged earth mark where an ancient bedrock colossus woke from sleep.
weather_lines: Sulfurous steam vents from cracked coastal rock.
Sea fog curls around rusted iron plates.
Heavy, static air tastes of hot copper and salt.
ambient_sounds_text: Steam hisses from ancient pressure-relief valves.
Loose scree crunches under heavy iron treads.
Low metallic groans echo across the crater.

name: Cliffside Culverin Battery
enter_line: Bronze coastal guns command the bay above hundred-foot drops and crashing breakers.
weather_lines: Salt-laden gusts whip sparks from slow-matches.
Low sea-clouds drift past the granite parapet.
Cold spray rises from the breakers far below.
ambient_sounds_text: Waves crash thunderously against sheer cliff bases.
Heavy siege-carriages creak on wooden tracks.
Canvas powder-covers flap in brisk sea wind.

name: Blazing Harbor Quays
enter_line: Pitch-fed fire-hulks light up choppy black water as burning masts topple onto piers.
weather_lines: Thick black oil-smoke blots out the night sky.
Blistering orange heat radiates off burning hulls.
Sparks rain down like red snow in harbor gusts.
ambient_sounds_text: Tarred ship-timbers roar like open furnaces.
Boiling seawater hisses around charred pilings.
Rigging snaps and crashes onto stone quays.

name: Ironcamp Slag Foundry
enter_line: Trip-hammers thunder day and night beside open caldera fissures glowing with white heat.
weather_lines: Thick coal-smog stings every drawn breath.
Grey volcanic ash sifts onto tavern roofs.
Dry furnace heat radiates from slag-heap walls.
ambient_sounds_text: Heavy trip-hammers shake soot from iron rafters.
Quenching troughs hiss violently with sulfur steam.
Sharpening wheels shriek against meteoric steel.

name: Scorched Basalt Highway
enter_line: Toppled milestones and blistered orchards line the straight imperial road into the caldera.
weather_lines: Heat shimmer warps the distant volcanic ridge.
Fine grey ash crunches like frost under boots.
Dry, sulfurous wind parches lips and throat.
ambient_sounds_text: Basalt paving slabs pop softly in intense heat.
Ash drifts across stone with a dry whisper.
Distant war-horns echo from the inner hills.

name: Cold-Slag Beacon Towers
enter_line: Shattered signal mirrors and traitors' armor litter hilltop pyres extinguished from within.
weather_lines: Howling ash-winds sweep the exposed watch-decks.
Bruised crimson skies loom over cold fire-bowls.
Chilling night drafts follow blistering afternoons.
ambient_sounds_text: Broken bronze mirrors rattle in dusty gusts.
Torn traitors' pennants snap on iron poles.
Cold slag crunches beneath patrol boots.

name: Ironcamp Curtain Rampart
enter_line: Cracked basalt walls shudder under glowing slag-stones and sappers' picks below.
weather_lines: Thick siege-smoke obscures the outer glacis.
Glowing cinders rain down across parapet walks.
Hot sulfurous drafts rise from cratered stone.
ambient_sounds_text: Heavy basalt blocks groan under artillery impact.
Sappers' iron picks echo beneath the foundations.
Quenching water hisses on burning timber hoardings.

name: Ashveil Switchback Canyon
enter_line: Narrow obsidian trails wind beneath flickering rift-gates where turncoats hold the heights.
weather_lines: Violet rift-sparks crackle through falling ash.
Hot canyon winds funnel soot into blinding clouds.
Ominous crimson twilight stains the cliff walls.
ambient_sounds_text: Shod hooves clatter sharply on volcanic glass.
Static arcs snap between jagged obsidian crags.
Rear-guard blades ring along narrow switchbacks.

name: The Trench-Maze Gauntlet
enter_line: Enfilading ballista slits and oil-soaked faggots turn every sunken traverse into a kill-box.
weather_lines: Oily black smoke clings inside narrow ditches.
Dry heat radiates off pitch-soaked timber walls.
Ash falls steadily into spiked mud pits.
ambient_sounds_text: Repeating ballistae click as heavy cords wind.
Oil-soaked brush crackles near glowing braziers.
Bolts whistle sharply down narrow trench bends.

name: Soot-Velvet Outer Glacis
enter_line: Steep volcanic stone leaves storming columns exposed beneath gaping murder-holes.
weather_lines: Blistering midday sun turns black stone white-hot.
Soot flakes drift downward like black winter snow.
Sudden evening chill cracks heated basalt.
ambient_sounds_text: Heavy iron portcullises groan behind stone bars.
Loose pumice skitters down the steep approach.
Boiling slag-cauldrons bubble above murder-holes.

name: Three-Roads Star Bastion
enter_line: Three converging causeways lock down the ash plains under crossfire from battered towers.
weather_lines: Three dust plumes rise through grey ash-clouds.
Hot cross-winds carry war-drum beats across plains.
Smoke-choked skies glow dull red at noon.
ambient_sounds_text: War-drums pound steadily from three directions.
Steel clashes continuously along outer bastions.
Messengers' boots pound across stone causeways.

name: Colonnade of Conquered Crowns
enter_line: Polished black marble mirrors guttering coal-braziers beneath twelve chained provincial crowns.
weather_lines: Suffocating, still heat hangs beneath vast arches.
Brazier smoke coils around tarnished royal chains.
Cold draft from the dais chills sweat-soaked mail.
ambient_sounds_text: Iron footsteps echo endlessly down marble halls.
Tarnished crowns clink softly on suspended chains.
Coal braziers crackle in dead liturgical silence.

name: The Obsidian Dais Caldera
enter_line: Magma moats split the geometric sanctuary where the last Anchor Seals fracture in open air.
weather_lines: Cinders rise upward like inverted red snow.
Intense volcanic glare warps air and steel alike.
Bruised skies rumble above the open caldera.
ambient_sounds_text: Molten rock bubbles sluggishly in stone moats.
Meteoric Anchor Seals hum at a bone-deep pitch.
The threshold bell tolls through drifting ash.
